_comment: Legitimate workflow security findings. Hard-capped at 20 entries (lint_workflow_security.py ALLOWLIST_CAP). Exceeding the cap signals the linter is wrong, not the content — tighten the heuristic, do not grow this list (autonomous-execution allowlist-growth antipattern). Each entry MUST cite why the finding is acceptable in `reason`.

findings.reason: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2 — sticky PR comment for bench drift reporting; no code execution, output-only action. SHA-pinning tracked in road-to-security-hardening P3.
